Container.Name: spela
Container.Overview:
A storefront for your own PS5 game backups. Browse them from any device in your home, and install them to a PS5 that already runs homebrew (ShadowMountPlus) over your network. Spela provides no games: it only works with backups you already have.
Choose the admin password within 10 minutes of the first start. After that it asks for a setup code, which is in the container's log; restarting the container gives another 10 minutes. In Spela, add your games as /games/...
Container.Requires: A PS5 that already runs homebrew: an ELF loader on port 9021 and ShadowMountPlus.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: The share with your PS5 games. In Spela, add them as /games/... It's writable so Spela can save .exfat images it converts next to a game.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Spela's settings, covers and save backups. Archives are unpacked here too, so it needs room for a whole game.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The port of Spela's web page. Host networking lets Spela find your PS5 by itself, so this is set here rather than as a port mapping.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Names you open Spela by besides its IP address, comma-separated, like tower.local. Any other name is refused.
